summary: Google DeepMind released Optax v0.2.8, an update to its JAX-based gradient processing and optimization library, removing a legacy pmap compatibility flag and adding several optimizer features and bug fixes.

practices.reason: Teams using the old jax.pmap behavior via the removed config flag must migrate their code following JAX's migration guide or pin to an earlier JAX version.
practices.quote: the `jax_pmap_shmap_merge` config flag was removed so that the `jax.pmap` implementation is always based on `jax.jit` and `jax.shard_map`, and opting into the old `jax.pmap` behavior is no longer an option.
